title: wolfssl_rsa_sign: returns -EINVAL for public-key op, not -ENOKEY
description: wolfssl_rsa_sign checks ctx->key_type==CRYPTO2DEV_KEY_PUBLIC and returns -EINVAL with comment 'sign requires private key'. wolfssl_ecdsa_sign correctly returns -ENOKEY for the same situation. Similarly wolfssl_ecdh_agree returns -EINVAL for a public key. Correct errno is -ENOKEY ('Required key not available'), not -EINVAL ('Invalid argument'). -EINVAL is for malformed parameters; wrong key type for an operation is -ENOKEY. Inconsistency means callers cannot write a single error-handling path for 'wrong key type' across RSA and ECDSA.
